text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, her very first goal. El 
Condor Pasa had finally stepped onto that 
grand stage.

It was precisely because she gained skill, 
confidence, and above all, a sense of 
mission to entertain everyone that El 
Condor Pasa was able to come this far.

Declaring that she was going to enjoy 
racing alongside Special Week and fierce 
rivals from overseas, she headed off to 
the track.
